issues.description: In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java the fields are declared in snake_case (lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students, number_of_guest_students, number_of_lecturers, number_of_tutors), but the constructor, getters/setters, toString, and other methods refer to camelCase fields (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) that are not declared. This makes the reference solution not compile and also conflicts with the problem statement/UML which specify camelCase attribute names.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution use one consistent naming scheme aligned with the UML: rename the declared fields to camelCase (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) or alternatively change all method bodies to consistently use the existing snake_case field names.
